stage: instrumentation_and_fixed_state_experiment; no learned gate or model tuning
baseline_version: frozen E full; barr-v0.4 tag remains unchanged
physical_source: CP-SCALE-AU-L002; eight configurations share one physical mother source

capture.sampling_scope: positive-opportunity enriched and time-threshold conditioned; no population prevalence or recall inference

fork.budget_scope: a freshly assigned common future budget from frozen decision state; not the remainder of the original six-minute capture call
fork.other_seeds: rekey future streams identically per pair, retaining all other frozen state
fork.future_policy: shared local/fusion continuation; no further joint recovery in either arm
fork.action: the verified pair only; no larger Kernel or refinement
fork.shared_sunk_cost: capturing state and finding the pair are measured separately; this first label conditions on an already-known action
complete_frozen_state: all population masks and local mutable internals
archive raw objective, tick bookkeeping and mask
controller round, epoch, stale, timing offsets and caches
temporary post-fusion state and feedback target
known pair and raw/integer witness proof

allocation.arm_order: deterministically balanced before reading fork outcomes

endpoints: each arm archive gain over common frozen archive
direct action archive refresh and gain
native wall and CPU; action and continuation costs separated
population normalized pairwise Hamming, weighted Hamming and distinct masks before action, after action, terminal
statistical_scope: state-level five paired-future-stream estimates with variation/uncertainty; states and configurations not independent datasets; labels are estimates rather than proof of intrinsic action value
failure_policy: retain all missing, failed and resource-flagged positions; no automatic solver reruns; never kill native programs or shut down server
isolation: new source, scripts, outputs and remote directory; old E/A/B/C/F source/results/report/release/tag unchanged
release_policy: this phase produces evidence and a separate staged report; no final-paper-algorithm declaration or GNN claim
